samples.question: Gray seams never fail: SAME keeps socket order top-to-bottom; FLIP reverses it. The red spark starts a failure that spreads only between pale circles joined directly by black links. Every reached pale circle and all links touching it disappear. Colored circles and square sockets stop the spread and never fail. After the spread stops, which matching color pair is still connected? Answer amber, cyan, or violet.
